definitions.appIntent: Known App Intent entry point, including Siri, Shortcuts and configured controls; exact invocation method is not observable.
definitions.baselineSources: Already-completed records when observation began; excluded from pilot completions. Nil legacy provenance is unknown.
definitions.completion: First committed full/light transition per occurrence during observation; retries and reopen/recomplete never add another event. Undo does not remove a past observation.
definitions.coverage: Local optional diagnostics may omit events after an I/O failure or interruption. No automatic upload. Restoring a backup is not a completion event.
definitions.day: 1-based civil day in the timezone captured at opt-in. Day 7/14 are awaiting until that civil day ends.
definitions.failures: Best-effort failed action attempts by category and entry point; repeated failures may count again and are not activation metrics.
definitions.setup: First empty-app onboarding or manual-create opening after opt-in. Missing timing is unknown, not zero.
